from pathlib import Path
import json
import math
import random
import statistics
import subprocess
import time

import chess
import numpy as np
import torch

from harbichess.backends.torch_backend import TorchPolicyValueBackend
from harbichess.backends.torch_network import load_weights, sha256
from harbichess.chess.rules import PythonChessRules
from harbichess.core.state import ChessMove, ChessState
from harbichess.evaluation.root_budget import CountingEvaluator
from harbichess.evaluation.teacher_probe import StockfishReference, OracleValueEvaluator
from harbichess.search.batching import SharedBatchEvaluator
from harbichess.search.evaluator import NeuralPositionEvaluator
from harbichess.search.full_gumbel import FullGumbelConfig, FullGumbelMCTS

root = Path('/workspace/HarbiChess')
source = Path('/workspace/work/harbichess/broad-diagnostic-pinned')
directory = root / 'artifacts/ufuk-broad-policy-value-diagnostic-v2-20261004'
started = time.perf_counter()
deadline = float(__import__('os').environ['UFUK_DIAGNOSTIC_DEADLINE'])
torch.set_num_threads(1)
torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=source, text=True).strip() == '5d2e95c56c1a0367b18157a734622d8372cafdc1'
assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], cwd=source, text=True) == ''
book = root / 'docs/research/UFUK-broad-history-strength-opening-splits-20261004.json'
assert sha256(book) == 'd3b9a49e3c60cdce62a672fbfc8ae8ab2a5167ed38cc5781432a8559e0891765'
positions = json.loads(book.read_text())['splits']['arena']
assert len(positions) == 48 and len({p['source_game'] for p in positions}) == 48
weights = {
    'original': root / 'artifacts/ufuk-all-train-20261003/checkpoints/step-009250/model.safetensors',
    'candidate': root / 'artifacts/ufuk-broad-v4-train-seed-20261026-candidate-20261004/checkpoints/step-030000/model.safetensors',
}
expected = {'original': '18f2aae5a4dca317229b87af17ee393a4e786db3369e54aaf32c926a811cb5ae', 'candidate': 'e8fe6d4da5dd4726ff860ba760ff2830070b5e9008c123968fcee1b0f4c1af03'}
assert {k: sha256(p) for k, p in weights.items()} == expected
rules = PythonChessRules()
bridges = {k: SharedBatchEvaluator(TorchPolicyValueBackend(load_weights(p).eval()), max_batch_size=1, max_wait_seconds=0) for k, p in weights.items()}
evaluators = {k: CountingEvaluator(NeuralPositionEvaluator(v, rules=rules)) for k, v in bridges.items()}
old = root / 'artifacts/ufuk-broad-policy-value-diagnostic-20261004'
immutable = json.loads((Path('/workspace/work/harbichess') / 'ufuk-broad-diagnostic-v1-immutable-inputs.json').read_text())
for filename, info in immutable.items():
    binary = (old / filename).read_bytes()
    assert len(binary) == info['bytes'] and sha256(old / filename) == info['sha256']
old_execution = json.loads((old / 'execution.json').read_text())
assert old_execution['status'] == 'incomplete' and old_execution['roots_completed'] == 47 and old_execution['engine_calls'] == 2501
for model, count in old_execution['nn_calls'].items():
    evaluators[model].calls = count
rows = [json.loads(line) for line in (old / 'positions.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
old_queries = [json.loads(line) for line in (old / 'queries.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
assert len(rows) == 47 and len(old_queries) == 2501
reference_cache = {(tuple(q['moves']), q['forced']): {k: v for k, v in q.items() if k not in ('query', 'root_fen', 'moves')} for q in old_queries if q['budget_nodes'] == 32768}
assert len(reference_cache) == sum(q['budget_nodes'] == 32768 for q in old_queries)

status = 'incomplete'
reason = 'not started'
with (directory / 'queries.jsonl').open('x') as querylog, (directory / 'positions.jsonl').open('x') as progress:
    engine_path = root / '../work/harbichess/stockfish/stockfish-linux-x86-64-universal'
    assert sha256(engine_path) == '0f83d24cc46d2c66c60f16001af5444873bc112b7d028594513426894c12da19'
    reference = StockfishReference(engine_path, rules, deadline, querylog)
    reference.calls = len(old_queries)
    reference.nodes = sum(q['nodes'] for q in old_queries)
    querylog.write((old / 'queries.jsonl').read_text())
    progress.write((old / 'positions.jsonl').read_text())
    def cached_reference(state, nodes, forced=None):
        key = (tuple(m.uci for m in state.moves), forced.uci if forced else None)
        return reference_cache[key] if key in reference_cache else reference.analyse(state, nodes, forced=forced)
    def guard():
        if time.perf_counter() >= deadline or reference.calls > 2600 or reference.nodes > 80000000 or sum(e.calls for e in evaluators.values()) > 25000:
            raise TimeoutError('registered deadline/query/node/neural-call ceiling')

    try:
        for index, row in enumerate(positions):
            if index < 47:
                assert rows[index]['moves'] == row['opening']['moves']
                continue
            guard()
            moves = row['opening']['moves']
            board = chess.Board()
            for uci in moves:
                move = chess.Move.from_uci(uci)
                assert move in board.legal_moves
                board.push(move)
            assert board.fen() == row['opening']['fen'] and board.outcome(claim_draw=True) is None
            state = ChessState(chess.STARTING_FEN, tuple(ChessMove(m) for m in moves))
            legal = sorted(m.uci() for m in board.legal_moves)
            root_reference = cached_reference(state, 32768)
            references = {}
            for move in legal:
                guard()
                references[move] = cached_reference(state, 32768, forced=ChessMove(move))
                querylog.flush()
            assert set(references) == set(legal)
            item = {'index': index, 'family': row['family'], 'source_game': row['source_game'],
                    'root_fen': chess.STARTING_FEN, 'moves': moves, 'fen': board.fen(),
                    'root_reference': root_reference, 'legal_references': references, 'arms': {}, 'raw': {}}
            order = ['original', 'candidate'] if index % 2 == 0 else ['candidate', 'original']
            for model in order:
                guard()
                beginning = time.perf_counter()
                evaluation = evaluators[model].evaluate(state)
                priors = {m.uci: p for m, p in evaluation.priors}
                assert set(priors) == set(legal)
                ranking = sorted(legal, key=lambda m: (-priors[m], m))
                selected = ranking[0]
                best = min(legal, key=lambda m: (-references[m]['cp_or_mate_score'], m))
                item['raw'][model] = {'priors': priors, 'value': evaluation.value,
                                      'root_q_absolute_error': abs(evaluation.value - (root_reference['wdl'][0] - root_reference['wdl'][2])),
                                      'highest_reference_cp_move': best, 'highest_reference_cp_policy_rank': ranking.index(best) + 1,
                                      'policy_reference_expected_score': sum(priors[m] * references[m]['expected_score'] for m in legal)}
                item['arms'][model + '-raw'] = {'selected': selected, 'selected_expected_score': references[selected]['expected_score'],
                                              'wall_seconds': time.perf_counter() - beginning, 'nn_calls': 1, 'engine_calls': 0, 'engine_nodes': 0}
            searches = ['candidate16', 'candidate64', 'candidate256', 'oracle16']
            searches = searches[index % 4:] + searches[:index % 4]
            for arm in searches:
                guard()
                before_nn, before_calls, before_nodes = evaluators['candidate'].calls, reference.calls, reference.nodes
                beginning = time.perf_counter()
                evaluator = OracleValueEvaluator(evaluators['candidate'], reference) if arm == 'oracle16' else evaluators['candidate']
                count = 16 if arm == 'oracle16' else int(arm.removeprefix('candidate'))
                result = FullGumbelMCTS(evaluator, rules=rules, config=FullGumbelConfig(simulations=count, max_considered_actions=4, gumbel_scale=0)).search(state, rng=random.Random(f'20261029:{index}'))
                wall = time.perf_counter() - beginning
                selected = result.selected_action.uci
                assert selected in legal and sum(m.visits for m in result.moves) == count
                item['arms'][arm] = {'selected': selected, 'selected_expected_score': references[selected]['expected_score'],
                                    'wall_seconds': wall, 'nn_calls': evaluators['candidate'].calls - before_nn,
                                    'engine_calls': reference.calls - before_calls, 'engine_nodes': reference.nodes - before_nodes,
                                    'root_value': result.root_value, 'visits': {m.move.uci: m.visits for m in result.moves},
                                    'target': {m.uci: p for m, p in result.action_weights}}
                guard()
            rows.append(item)
            progress.write(json.dumps(item) + '\n')
            progress.flush()
            querylog.flush()
            print(json.dumps({'event': 'progress', 'roots': len(rows), 'queries': reference.calls, 'actual_nodes': reference.nodes,
                              'neural_calls': sum(e.calls for e in evaluators.values()), 'wall_seconds_after_import': time.perf_counter() - started}), flush=True)
        guard()
        status, reason = 'completed', 'all48roots/alllegal/references/sixselectors'
    except Exception as e:
        reason = f'{type(e).__name__}: {e}'
        raise
    finally:
        for bridge in bridges.values():
            bridge.close()
        reference.close()
        (directory / 'execution.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status': status, 'reason': reason, 'roots_completed': len(rows), 'engine_calls': reference.calls,
                                                             'engine_actual_nodes': reference.nodes, 'nn_calls': {k: v.calls for k, v in evaluators.items()},
                                                             'wall_seconds_after_import': time.perf_counter() - started}, indent=2) + '\n')

contrasts = {}
for name, candidate, control in [('raw-candidate-minus-original', 'candidate-raw', 'original-raw'),
                                  ('candidate16-minus-raw', 'candidate16', 'candidate-raw'),
                                  ('candidate64-minus16', 'candidate64', 'candidate16'),
                                  ('candidate256-minus16', 'candidate256', 'candidate16'),
                                  ('oracle16-minus-learned16', 'oracle16', 'candidate16')]:
    values = [r['arms'][candidate]['selected_expected_score'] - r['arms'][control]['selected_expected_score'] for r in rows]
    rng = random.Random(20261029)
    samples = [sum(rng.choices(values, k=48)) / 48 for _ in range(50000)]
    low, high = np.quantile(samples, [.005, .995], method='linear').tolist()
    mean = statistics.mean(values)
    radius = math.sqrt(2 * math.log(200) / 48)
    wall_ratio = statistics.median(r['arms'][candidate]['wall_seconds'] / r['arms'][control]['wall_seconds'] for r in rows)
    quality = mean >= .02 and low > 0
    cost = wall_ratio <= (5 if candidate == 'candidate64' else 20) if candidate in ('candidate64', 'candidate256') else True
    contrasts[name] = {'mean': mean, 'family_differences': values, 'bootstrap_adjusted_99': [low, high],
                       'bootstrap_descriptive_95': np.quantile(samples, [.025, .975], method='linear').tolist(),
                       'hoeffding_adjusted_99': [max(-1, mean - radius), min(1, mean + radius)],
                       'median_paired_wall_ratio': wall_ratio, 'quality_gate_passed': quality, 'cost_gate_passed': cost,
                       'bounded_diagnostic_gate_passed': quality and cost, 'oracle_diagnostic_only': candidate == 'oracle16'}
summary = {arm: {'mean_selected_expected_score': statistics.mean(r['arms'][arm]['selected_expected_score'] for r in rows),
                 'total_wall_seconds': sum(r['arms'][arm]['wall_seconds'] for r in rows),
                 'nn_calls': sum(r['arms'][arm]['nn_calls'] for r in rows),
                 'engine_calls': sum(r['arms'][arm]['engine_calls'] for r in rows),
                 'engine_nodes': sum(r['arms'][arm]['engine_nodes'] for r in rows)} for arm in rows[0]['arms']}
raw = {model: {'mean_root_q_absolute_error': statistics.mean(r['raw'][model]['root_q_absolute_error'] for r in rows),
               'highest_reference_cp_policy_top4_fraction': statistics.mean(r['raw'][model]['highest_reference_cp_policy_rank'] <= 4 for r in rows),
               'mean_policy_reference_expected_score': statistics.mean(r['raw'][model]['policy_reference_expected_score'] for r in rows)} for model in weights}
report = {'schema': 1, 'status': status, 'reason': reason, 'roots': len(rows), 'source_commit': '5d2e95c56c1a0367b18157a734622d8372cafdc1',
          'script_sha256': sha256(Path(__file__)), 'book_sha256': sha256(book), 'weights_sha256': expected, 'engine_calls': reference.calls,
          'engine_actual_nodes': reference.nodes, 'summary': summary, 'raw_diagnostics': raw, 'contrasts': contrasts,
          'wall_seconds_after_import': time.perf_counter() - started,
          'version': 2, 'v1_source_input_hashes': immutable, 'reused_v1_completed_roots': 47, 'reused_v1_queries': 2501, 'new_engine_calls': reference.calls - 2501,
          'scope': 'Version2 explicit immutable data continuation after FAILED v1 count budget; conditional observed48root diagnostic, finite-budget fulllegal teacher references. No training, final holdout/game strength, learned oracle, genuine self-learning, Stockfish level, novelty or promotion.'}
(directory / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in report.items() if k not in ('contrasts',)}), flush=True)

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import time

root = Path('/workspace/HarbiChess')
work = Path('/workspace/work/harbichess')
source = work / 'broad-diagnostic-pinned'
directory = root / 'artifacts/ufuk-broad-policy-value-diagnostic-v2-20261004'
directory.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
start = time.perf_counter()
env = os.environ.copy()
env['PYTHONPATH'] = str(source / 'src')
original_epoch = 1791109193.4371672
remaining = original_epoch + 1800 - time.time()
assert remaining > 0
env['UFUK_DIAGNOSTIC_DEADLINE'] = str(start + remaining)
command = [str(root / '.venv/bin/python'), str(work / 'run-ufuk-broad-policy-value-diagnostic-v2.py')]
receipt = {'command': command, 'cwd': str(source), 'PYTHONPATH': env['PYTHONPATH'],
           'whole_wall_ceiling_seconds': remaining, 'original_stage_started_epoch': original_epoch, 'original_stage_ceiling_seconds': 1800, 'started_epoch': time.time(), 'source_commit': '5d2e95c56c1a0367b18157a734622d8372cafdc1'}
(directory / 'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
failure = None
with (directory / 'stdout.log').open('x') as out, (directory / 'stderr.log').open('x') as err:
    process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=source, env=env, stdout=out, stderr=err, start_new_session=True)
    while process.poll() is None:
        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
        memory = int(Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.current').read_text())
        disk = shutil.disk_usage(root).free
        (directory / 'parent-progress.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status': 'running', 'pid': process.pid, 'elapsed_seconds': elapsed, 'memory_current_bytes': memory, 'disk_free_bytes': disk}) + '\n')
        if elapsed >= remaining or memory > 15 * 1024**3 or disk < 8 * 1024**3:
            failure = 'whole-wall/memory/disk ceiling'
            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            try:
                process.wait(timeout=5)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                process.wait()
            break
        time.sleep(1)
elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
if elapsed >= remaining and failure is None:
    failure = 'whole clock exceeded ceiling'
receipt.update({'returncode': process.returncode, 'failure': failure, 'whole_wall_seconds': elapsed, 'finished_epoch': time.time(),
                'charged_original_stage_whole_seconds': time.time() - original_epoch, 'status': 'completed-awaiting-independent-audit' if process.returncode == 0 and failure is None else 'failed-or-incomplete-no-promotion'})
(directory / 'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(receipt), flush=True)
if failure is not None or process.returncode != 0:
    raise SystemExit(2)

import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import random
import statistics
import time

import chess
import numpy as np

started = time.perf_counter()
root = Path('/workspace/HarbiChess')
directory = root / 'artifacts/ufuk-broad-policy-value-diagnostic-v2-20261004'
receipt = json.loads((directory / 'receipt.json').read_text())
assert receipt['charged_original_stage_whole_seconds'] < 1800
assert receipt['returncode'] == 0 and receipt['failure'] is None and receipt['whole_wall_seconds'] < 1800
book = root / 'docs/research/UFUK-broad-history-strength-opening-splits-20261004.json'
assert hashlib.sha256(book.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'd3b9a49e3c60cdce62a672fbfc8ae8ab2a5167ed38cc5781432a8559e0891765'
roots = json.loads(book.read_text())['splits']['arena']
rows = [json.loads(s) for s in (directory / 'positions.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
queries = [json.loads(s) for s in (directory / 'queries.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
result = json.loads((directory / 'result.json').read_text())
execution = json.loads((directory / 'execution.json').read_text())
assert len(rows) == len(roots) == 48 and result['status'] == execution['status'] == 'completed'
old = root / 'artifacts/ufuk-broad-policy-value-diagnostic-20261004'
assert (directory / 'positions.jsonl').read_bytes().startswith((old / 'positions.jsonl').read_bytes())
assert (directory / 'queries.jsonl').read_bytes().startswith((old / 'queries.jsonl').read_bytes())
for filename, info in result['v1_source_input_hashes'].items():
    binary = (old / filename).read_bytes()
    assert len(binary) == info['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(binary).hexdigest() == info['sha256']
assert result['reused_v1_completed_roots'] == 47 and result['reused_v1_queries'] == 2501
nodes = 0
replayed = 0
for index, q in enumerate(queries, 1):
    assert q['query'] == index and q['root_fen'] == chess.STARTING_FEN
    board = chess.Board(q['root_fen'])
    for uci in q['moves']:
        move = chess.Move.from_uci(uci)
        assert move in board.legal_moves
        board.push(move)
        replayed += 1
    legal = {m.uci() for m in board.legal_moves}
    assert board.outcome(claim_draw=True) is None and q['move'] in legal
    if q['forced'] is not None:
        assert q['forced'] == q['move'] and q['forced'] in legal
    assert not q['lowerbound'] and not q['upperbound']
    assert len(q['wdl']) == 3 and all(math.isfinite(v) and 0 <= v <= 1 for v in q['wdl'])
    assert abs(sum(q['wdl']) - 1) < 1e-12
    assert abs(q['expected_score'] - (q['wdl'][0] + q['wdl'][1] / 2)) < 1e-12
    assert q['budget_nodes'] in (1024, 32768) and type(q['nodes']) is int and q['nodes'] >= 0
    nodes += q['nodes']
assert len(queries) == result['engine_calls'] == execution['engine_calls'] <= 2600
assert nodes == result['engine_actual_nodes'] == execution['engine_actual_nodes'] <= 80000000
queries_by_key = {}
for q in queries:
    if q['budget_nodes'] == 32768:
        key = (tuple(q['moves']), q['forced'])
        assert key not in queries_by_key
        queries_by_key[key] = q
for index, (r, original) in enumerate(zip(rows, roots, strict=True)):
    assert r['index'] == index and r['family'] == original['family'] and r['source_game'] == original['source_game']
    assert r['root_fen'] == chess.STARTING_FEN and r['moves'] == original['opening']['moves']
    board = chess.Board()
    for uci in r['moves']:
        board.push_uci(uci)
    assert board.fen() == r['fen'] == original['opening']['fen']
    legal = {m.uci() for m in board.legal_moves}
    assert legal == set(r['legal_references'])
    for forced, reference in [(None, r['root_reference']), *r['legal_references'].items()]:
        q = queries_by_key[(tuple(r['moves']), forced)]
        assert all(reference[k] == q[k] for k in reference)
    for model in ('original', 'candidate'):
        raw = r['raw'][model]
        assert set(raw['priors']) == legal and abs(sum(raw['priors'].values()) - 1) < 1e-12
        assert all(math.isfinite(p) and 0 <= p <= 1 for p in raw['priors'].values())
        best = min(legal, key=lambda m: (-r['legal_references'][m]['cp_or_mate_score'], m))
        rank = sorted(legal, key=lambda m: (-raw['priors'][m], m)).index(best) + 1
        assert best == raw['highest_reference_cp_move'] and rank == raw['highest_reference_cp_policy_rank']
        assert r['arms'][model + '-raw']['selected'] == min(legal, key=lambda m: (-raw['priors'][m], m))
    assert set(r['arms']) == {'original-raw', 'candidate-raw', 'candidate16', 'candidate64', 'candidate256', 'oracle16'}
    for arm, a in r['arms'].items():
        assert a['selected'] in legal and a['selected_expected_score'] == r['legal_references'][a['selected']]['expected_score']
        assert a['wall_seconds'] > 0 and a['nn_calls'] > 0
        if not arm.endswith('-raw'):
            count = 16 if arm == 'oracle16' else int(arm.removeprefix('candidate'))
            assert set(a['target']) == set(a['visits']) == legal and sum(a['visits'].values()) == count
            assert abs(sum(a['target'].values()) - 1) < 1e-12
    assert time.perf_counter() - started < 290
for name, candidate, control in [('raw-candidate-minus-original', 'candidate-raw', 'original-raw'), ('candidate16-minus-raw', 'candidate16', 'candidate-raw'),
                                  ('candidate64-minus16', 'candidate64', 'candidate16'), ('candidate256-minus16', 'candidate256', 'candidate16'),
                                  ('oracle16-minus-learned16', 'oracle16', 'candidate16')]:
    values = [r['arms'][candidate]['selected_expected_score'] - r['arms'][control]['selected_expected_score'] for r in rows]
    rng = random.Random(20261029)
    samples = [sum(rng.choices(values, k=48)) / 48 for _ in range(50000)]
    low, high = np.quantile(samples, [.005, .995], method='linear').tolist()
    c = result['contrasts'][name]
    assert c['family_differences'] == values and c['mean'] == statistics.mean(values)
    assert c['bootstrap_adjusted_99'] == [low, high]
    ratio = statistics.median(r['arms'][candidate]['wall_seconds'] / r['arms'][control]['wall_seconds'] for r in rows)
    assert ratio == c['median_paired_wall_ratio']
    quality = c['mean'] >= .02 and low > 0
    cost = ratio <= (5 if candidate == 'candidate64' else 20) if candidate in ('candidate64', 'candidate256') else True
    assert c['quality_gate_passed'] == quality and c['cost_gate_passed'] == cost and c['bounded_diagnostic_gate_passed'] == (quality and cost)
assert sum(execution['nn_calls'].values()) <= 26000
for arm, s in result['summary'].items():
    for field in ('nn_calls', 'engine_calls', 'engine_nodes'):
        assert s[field] == sum(r['arms'][arm][field] for r in rows)
    assert s['mean_selected_expected_score'] == statistics.mean(r['arms'][arm]['selected_expected_score'] for r in rows)
controls = json.loads((root / 'docs/runs/UFUK-broad-policy-value-diagnostic-v2-controls-20261004.json').read_text())
for f in controls['files']:
    b = Path('/workspace/work/harbichess', Path(f['path']).name).read_bytes()
    assert len(b) == f['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() == f['sha256'] and b.decode() == f['text']
report = {'status': 'pass-integrity-and-fixed-statistics', 'roots': 48, 'queries': len(queries), 'actual_engine_nodes': nodes,
          'legal_query_history_plies_replayed': replayed, 'whole_diagnostic_seconds': receipt['whole_wall_seconds'],
          'audit_seconds_after_import': time.perf_counter() - started, 'source_scripts_unchanged': True,
          'scope': 'Independent persisted full-history/legal/alllegal/nativeSTM/count/statistical audit, no repeated engine queries or updates. Conditional diagnostic findings only; no strength/self-learning promotion.'}
(directory / 'independent-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(report), flush=True)

scope: Explicit data continuation with original failure retained, no training resume or new whole budget.
